issue.title: Retire queue_directive
issue.description: Beta gate for the %queue/%q split from %wait.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Runtime, editor, and all maintained producers use the split contract, so the Off branch can be deleted.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Queue admission stays on %wait(runners=) and %wait(priority=); explicit %queue/%q is a useful error, is stripped from model input, and is hidden from completion.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Queue admission uses %queue/%q with positional runners and p=; %wait keeps dependencies and time floors and rejects retired queue keywords with migration errors.

payload.entry: queue_directive is retired: runtime/editor launch contract is unconditional on %queue/%q; registry has no queue_directive entry or disabled branch. Published-wheel directive corpus passed at sase-core-rs 0.32.53 with the queue contract guarded against floors below 0.32.52, linked-core directive corpus passed, Neovim LSP queue completion smoke passed, and just check passed after full-suite escalation.
